note: Machine-readable subset of docs/observability-fields.md used by scripts/verify_observability_readback.py for stored-field comparisons. The authoritative expanded matrix (source/type/unit/owner/provenance/completeness/privacy/bounds/vendor/test/readback) is the versioned markdown document; this subset may only shrink relative to it, never add a field the doc omits. Vendor-reality notes (native readback evidence, 2026-09-09): HoneyHive elides empty config/metrics/feedback containers on returned events and synthesizes one aggregate 'session' event per session, so those containers are conditional (type-checked when present) rather than required; HoneyHive routes events into the session via the session_id filter only when the span carries traceloop.association.properties.* identity (see docs identity rows: All spans). LangSmith stores the OpenLLMetry association property daydream_run_id as run metadata at extra.metadata and rejects dotted-key metadata filters; top-level metadata/invocation_params/usage_metadata are not projected by /runs/query and are therefore conditional. LangSmith additionally enforces a ~24-hour OTLP ingest window on span start times (live 422: 'start_time for post must be within ≈24 hours of current time'); the sanitized protocol replay deliberately pins generation timestamps to its manifest's historical interval, so a replay whose pinned interval is older than the window is structurally absent from LangSmith — the verifier reports this as an honest READBACK_NOT_FOUND (zero discovered runs), never as root ambiguity.
